script: o=$(mktemp); kind(){ line=; read -r line < "$o"; case $line in "["*) echo full;; "") echo none;; *) echo pid;; esac; }; f(){ return 1; }; f & p=$!; while kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.01; done; jobs >/dev/null; /bin/sh -c 'exit 3' & wait %1; echo "jobspec=$?"; rm -f "$o"

o=$(mktemp); kind(){ line=; read -r line < "$o"; case $line in "["*) echo full;; "") echo none;; *) echo pid;; esac; }; /bin/sh -c 'exit 1' & p=$!; /bin/sh -c 'until [ ! -e "/proc/$1" ] || [ "$(cut -d " " -f 3 "/proc/$1/stat" 2>/dev/null)" = Z ]; do :; done' sh "$p"; jobs >/dev/null; /bin/sh -c 'exit 3' & wait %1; echo "jobspec=$?"; rm -f "$o"
